name: Cedric API
description:
Cedric is an AI employee for Slack, Telegram and Discord. He joins your meetings, works in the tools you connect and asks before anything is sent or changed.

This API reaches him from code: scripts, tests, automations and your own agents. Every caller acts as the person who signed in or owns the key, in their workspace, with their access and the workspace's credits.

Three endpoints: `/api/v1/chat` runs one whole turn and returns his reply, `/api/v1/files` uploads local files, and `/api/v1/mcp` is a Model Context Protocol server exposing his tools to any MCP client.

Keys are created in Cedric's Settings, on the MCP tab. A key has a mode, chosen when it is created: under a standard key, sends and writes wait for a person's approval; a direct key runs them immediately. Full reference: https://github.com/meet-cedric/cedric-mcp/blob/main/docs/api.md
